summary: Evaluates a Catmull-Rom Hermite cubic spline for a 2-component vector. Given parameter t=a6 and four 2D control points a2..a5, computes the four Catmull-Rom basis coefficients v10 = 2t^2 - t^3 - t, v11 = 3t^3 - 5t^2 + 2, v12 = 4t^2 - 3t^3 + t and v9 = t^3 - t^2, then writes the weighted blend scaled by 0.5 into the output vector a1 (x at a1[0], y at a1[1]). A standalone math helper with no branches and no callees; the prelabel name is retained.

local_names.a1: output 2-component float vector (x at [0], y at [1])

operations.description: Compute the Catmull-Rom basis coefficients from t=a6: v10 = 2t^2 - t^3 - t, v11 = 3t^3 - 5t^2 + 2, v12 = 4t^2 - 3t^3 + t, v9 = t^3 - t^2.
Write the interpolated X component: a1[0] = 0.5 * (v10 * a2[0] + v11 * a3[0] + v12 * a4[0] + v9 * a5[0]).
Write the interpolated Y component: a1[1] = 0.5 * (v9 * a5[1] + v12 * a4[1] + v11 * a3[1] + v10 * a2[1]).
Return the output vector pointer a1 unchanged.
